nodes.description: Private mapping address => uint256 recording token balances in ERC20.
Private nested mapping address => address => uint256 recording spend allowances.
Private uint256 holding the total token supply.
Private string token name, set once in the constructor.
Private string token symbol, set once in the constructor.
ANTIJINDOGE constructor; sets ERC20 metadata and mints the initial supply to the deployer.
Internal ERC20 _mint; increases total supply and credits an account balance.
Internal ERC20 _transfer; validates addresses and moves balances between accounts.
Internal ERC20 _burn; destroys tokens and reduces total supply.
Internal ERC20 _approve; writes the allowance mapping.
Public ERC20 transfer; delegates to _transfer with _msgSender as sender.
Public ERC20 transferFrom; checks and decrements allowance then transfers.
Public ERC20 approve; delegates to _approve with _msgSender as owner.
Public helper increasing spender allowance by addedValue.
Public helper decreasing spender allowance by subtractedValue.

Public view returning 18 decimals; used by the constructor for the mint amount.
Empty virtual hook invoked before every mint, transfer and burn.
Context helper returning msg.sender.
Context helper returning msg.data.
msg.sender: the externally controlled caller address.
Unrestricted one-shot mint in the constructor assigning the whole supply to msg.sender.
_totalSupply += amount inside _mint; supply arithmetic.
_balances[recipient] += amount inside _transfer; balance arithmetic on a possibly unchecked recipient.
currentAllowance - amount inside transferFrom; allowance subtraction after a transfer.
_totalSupply -= amount inside _burn; supply arithmetic.
senderBalance - amount inside _transfer; sender balance arithmetic.
Virtual _beforeTokenTransfer hook executed before state updates; overridable callback surface.

edges.reason: The ANTIJINDOGE constructor calls the internal _mint routine.
The constructor executes the one-shot mint of the entire supply.
msg.sender is passed as the mint beneficiary, granting the caller the full supply.
The constructor reads the externally controlled msg.sender to select the mint recipient.
_mint writes the credited balance into the _balances mapping.
_mint increases _totalSupply by the minted amount.
The _totalSupply += amount statement is the supply arithmetic sink.
_mint invokes the virtual _beforeTokenTransfer hook before state finalization, an overridable callback surface.
_transfer invokes the virtual _beforeTokenTransfer hook before balances are updated, enabling hook-based reentrancy.
_burn invokes the virtual _beforeTokenTransfer hook before balances are updated.
The external-facing hook sink is reachable from _transfer with state updates still pending.
_transfer reads and writes the _balances mapping for sender and recipient.
_balances[recipient] += amount is the recipient credit arithmetic.
senderBalance - amount is the sender debit arithmetic.
The local senderBalance snapshot feeds the debit computation.
_burn reads and writes the _balances mapping of the burned account.
_burn reduces the total supply state variable.
_totalSupply -= amount is the burn supply arithmetic.
The local accountBalance snapshot feeds the burn debit computation.
_approve writes the _allowances nested mapping.
transfer delegates the value movement to _transfer.
transfer uses _msgSender to identify the sender.
transferFrom delegates the value movement to _transfer.
transferFrom re-approves the reduced allowance through _approve.
transferFrom uses _msgSender to identify the spender.
transferFrom reads the current allowance into the local currentAllowance variable.
currentAllowance - amount is the allowance decrement arithmetic sink.
The local currentAllowance variable is the minuend of the allowance subtraction.
approve delegates the allowance write to _approve.
approve uses _msgSender as the allowance owner.
increaseAllowance delegates to _approve with the increased value.
increaseAllowance uses _msgSender as the allowance owner.
decreaseAllowance delegates to _approve with the decreased value.
decreaseAllowance uses _msgSender as the allowance owner.
decreaseAllowance reads the current allowance into a local variable before subtracting.
_msgSender returns the untrusted msg.sender value.
balanceOf reads the _balances mapping.
allowance reads the _allowances mapping.
